description: Will my travel insurance still be valid? Returns the FCDO 'Warnings and insurance' section for one country: the official warning levels, the areas they cover and the insurance guidance, as headed plain-text subsections, plus the machine-readable alert status. Live from the GOV.UK Content API. The FCDO's warning maps are images and are not returned; whether a particular policy pays out depends on its own terms. (cost: 1 credit)

country.description: string, required, country name, alternative name (city, island) or GOV.UK slug, e.g. "ukraine"

name: travel_advice_warnings_insurance
